descriptionChirho: To desire or wish for something, expressing a general or positive wanting without strong negative or emotional connotation (predominantly Piel stem and neutral Hitpael forms).
To crave, covet, or lust after something with intense and often morally negative desire, frequently used in prohibitions and descriptions of sinful craving (Hitpael stem with negative connotation).
To long for or yearn with deep emotional desire, expressing heartfelt longing or ardent aspiration toward something or someone (Hitpael stem with emotional/yearning connotation).
